title: docs(browser): fix locators.exact default
body:
### Description

`browser.locators.exact` defaults to `true` since #10430 (`resolved.browser.locators.exact ??= true`), and `docs/config/browser/locators.md` says `Default: true`. The JSDoc on `BrowserConfigOptions.locators.exact` still said `@default false`, which is what editors show on hover. This changes that one tag.

Resolves #11337

Prepared with Claude Code (Anthropic); I reviewed the change.
